ver: Version counter. Starts at 1; incremented on every write.
meta.title: Application name, copied from PRD meta.title.
meta.updated_at: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last write.
entities_implemented: List of entity IDs (from entity-catalog) for which model/schema files have been generated. Used in update mode to detect new or changed entities.
files_generated: Complete list of all model/schema files generated, as relative paths from the project root. One file per entity as a minimum; some tech stacks may produce additional migration or factory files.
setup_notes: Notes produced during generation — e.g. 'Run migrations before starting the server', 'Entity X uses polymorphic association — see models/x.py for details'. Empty array if none.
